data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for integrating Yandex Mobile Ads SDK on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter developers to easily integrate the Yandex Mobile Ads SDK into Android and iOS applications. Supports mediation libraries, banner ads, and fullscreen ads with stream-based APIs.
use_when: You want to monetize your mobile app using Yandex Mobile Ads
You need banner or fullscreen ads integrated with Android and iOS apps
avoid_when: You prefer using Google AdMob or other ad networks instead of Yandex
Your target platform is web or desktop
strengths: Supports multiple ad mediations and adapters
Swift Package Manager support for iOS
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration on both Android and iOS (e.g., build.gradle, Info.plist, SKAdNetwork items)
data.setup_notes: Requires adding platform dependencies in build.gradle for Android and Podfile or Swift Package Manager for iOS, along with adding configuration keys such as GADApplicationIdentifier and SKAdNetworkIdentifiers in Info.plist.

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use Google AdMob instead of Yandex Mobile Ads.

alternatives.name: unity_ads_plugin
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use Unity Ads for monetization.
